app.name: Conductor
app.primary_job: Read agent work, edit a project, and manage chats

screen.name: Workspace
screen.purpose: Read a conversation and inspect project changes beside it

spacing_grouping.instructions: In the images, how does spacing show what belongs together?
criteria: Gaps are random, or the same everywhere, so groups are hard to see
Groups exist, but some gaps break them or join unrelated items
Related items sit close together, gaps between groups are wider, and the same gap sizes repeat

spacing_alignment.instructions: In the images, do elements line up on shared left edges and columns?

spacing_consistent.instructions: In the images, do repeated components, such as rows, cards, tabs, and buttons, use the same padding and height?

quality_heading_spacing.instructions: In the images, is a heading closer to the section above it than to its own content?

quality_cramped.instructions: In the images, is text pressed against the edge of a button, a card, or the screen?

slop_monotonous_spacing.instructions: In the images, are all gaps the same size, so that related items are no closer together than separate groups?

type_line_height.instructions: In the images, does text with several lines have comfortable space between the lines?
